title.narrative: Zero Emission Public Transport in the AMA

description.narrative: The project intended to remove financial, legal, and cultural barriers needed to accelerate the adoption of e-buses in the Metropolitan Area of Asuncion public transport system and would directly support the introduction of at least 1,000 e-buses over 10 years powered by renewable energy. The project aimed to offer an incentive (grant) for the first 300 e-buses. The Government of Paraguay through its Ministry of Finance intended to exonerate the Value Added Tax on all e-bus sales and provide a soft loan program for bus operators and businesses involved in leasing buses, through the Financial Development Agency (AFD). To reduce the risk, funding from the Mitigation Action Facility was intended to be used to provide a loan guarantee on the soft loan program. The project aimed to directly leverage EUR 212 million and directly mitigate 1.7 million tons of CO2e over the lifetime of the vehicles.
